activity.role: SED First Secretary and de facto leader
activity.notes: Ulbricht held the decisive political authority in the GDR as head of the SED from 1950 until he was replaced by Erich Honecker on 3 May 1971. This Activity represents de facto political leadership rather than a constitutional head-of-state office.

sources.title: Walter Ulbricht — Bundesstiftung zur Aufarbeitung der SED-Diktatur
sources.citation_text: The Federal Foundation identifies Ulbricht as the dominant GDR politician, SED leader until May 1971, and Chairman of the State Council from 1960 until his death in 1973.
